notes.title: 08/05/2021 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have released a new version of AKIBA'S TRIP: Hellbound & Debriefed.

Build ID: 7134331

Update:
-Modified the initial formatting prompt so it's easier to advance past. It can now be closed with most buttons and will close automatically after 10 seconds.
